result.process_summary: Both the vending machine and a function receive an explicit trigger (button press / function call) together with inputs (payment or choice / parameters), perform internal processing that is hidden from the user, and optionally produce an observable result (item dispensed / returned value). When no tangible output is produced, the action still completes (light turns on / void function).
potential_breaks: A vending machine has a finite inventory that can be depleted, whereas a function can be invoked indefinitely without resource exhaustion.
The vending machine involves physical state changes and mechanical wear, while a function operates on abstract code without physical constraints.
Vending machines may require maintenance and refilling, concepts that have no direct analogue in pure functions.
